The '''Pyke blaster pistol''' was a model of [[blaster pistol]] owned by [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]].

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], after joining [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], the Pyke Syndicate used this weapon at the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. Lom Pyke was seen wielding this type of blaster pistol before [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] killed several [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|policemen]].
